Getting continuous data of bumble bee and pollinator activity

Our cameras give us data at an unprescedented resolution of time and space, allowing us to address pressing questions about the drivers of bumble bee and pollinator populations.

title: The BombusCam
text: The BombusCam is an automated camera trap designed to provide continuous, non-lethal monitoring of bumble bee biodiversity. It functions not unlike a trail camera does for monitoring vertebrate and game species, letting us document species diversity and understand how environmental conditions impact bumble bee activity and species persistence. We’re developing these tools with collaborators at Kansas State University and the Environmental Security Technology Certification Program (ESTCP)
